card.name: Verbs of ordering or arranging items
card.fires_on: Verbs or small words right after a verb that describe placing, assigning or arranging items in a sequence, such as assigned, allocated, in (order), lay the cards out. The next word is likely about order, such as alphabetical or one at a time.

modes.label: Assigning or allocating
modes.description: Verbs of handing out items in a set order.
modes.example: remaining seats are<< allocated>> one at a time, to the state

modes.label: Arranging in order
modes.description: A small word or object after a verb of placing things in a line or sequence.
modes.example: Clothespin the T-shirts<< in>> order to the line.

modes.label: Grouping or distributing people
modes.description: Objects of verbs that sort people or items into groups.
modes.example: Put<< students>> into groups of 3 or 4

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words about alphabetical or single-file ordering.
card.plain: It marks spots where text describes putting things in a particular order, so a word like alphabetical may come next.
